title: Variant (2003)
headline: Corollary 5.2 is false as originally printed. A corrigendum published in 2022, before this audit, already corrects it; the record documents a known error re-found by the method.

work.title: Bargaining with Outside Options and Deadlines

claims.label: Corollary 5.2 (as originally printed)
claims.gist: Agreement is immediate whenever the deadline is long enough.
claims.statement: If the deadline exceeds T*, every subgame-perfect equilibrium reaches agreement in the first period.

result.summary: A game with a long deadline and delayed agreement, as the 2022 corrigendum notes.
result.witness: With outside options close to half the pie, an equilibrium delays agreement to the second period even when the deadline exceeds T*.
result.tested: Re-derived from the original statement without using the corrigendum, then compared with it.
not_claimed: The paper's main characterization is not claimed to be false.
The corrected corollary is not claimed to be false.

vor_check.detail: The original statement checked on rendered pages; the corrigendum read in full.

checks.detail: The researcher re-derived the counterexample before reading the corrigendum.
A separate AI session confirmed the counterexample.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.novelty: Previously reported: the 2022 corrigendum corrects this corollary.

correction.note: Published by the author in 2022, before this audit.

statements.ai_use: Discovery and the separate rechecks used AI models in separate sessions. The independent reproduction, the version-of-record check and every editorial decision were done by the researcher.
